slides.headline: Snap your notes
slides.body: Photograph the pages your teacher covered. Handwriting is fine.

slides.headline: Quiz before you reread
slides.body: Answer first, then check. Getting it wrong is how you find the gaps.

slides.headline: Review only your misses
slides.body: Skip what you already know. Spend the time on the questions you got wrong.
